params.name: zoom
params.description: Zoom level. Z coordinate in the XYZ tiling scheme

params.name: x
params.description: X coordinate in the XYZ tiling scheme. Must be less than 2^zoom

params.name: y
params.description: Y coordinate in the XYZ tiling scheme. Must be less than 2^zoom

params.name: ttl
params.description:
Set the `Cache-Control` HTTP header with this value as `max-age`, in
seconds. This means subsequent identical requests will be cached on
iNaturalist servers, and commonly within web browsers

params.name: color
params.description:
Primary color to use in tile creation. Accepts common colors by string
(e.g. `color=blue`), and accepts escaped color HEX codes
(e.g. `color=%2386a91c`)
